# Vaelspire

> Ultra-lightweight Rust open-core identity and authentication platform by Neotales. Embed modular MIT crates in your Rust app or run one static binary with `/forward-auth`, Prometheus `/metrics`, and SQLite/PostgreSQL over `neotales-dbapi`. Security is 100% free; Enterprise adds multi-region geo-replication, WORM immutable audit storage, SIEM/OpenTelemetry pipelines, license seats, and FIPS 140-3.

- Core repository: https://github.com/neotales/vaelspire
- Marketing & documentation site repository: https://github.com/neotales/vaelspire-site
- Release rule: Documentation in `neotales/vaelspire-site` must be updated and verified before cutting any `vaelspire` release tag.

## Quick Links

- [60-Second Quickstart](/getting-started/quickstart/): One-command setup (`./scripts/dev-setup.sh`, `./scripts/quickstart.sh`, `./scripts/smoke-test.sh`)
- [Configuration & CLI](/getting-started/configuration/): `vaelspire` CLI subcommands and `VAELSPIRE_*` env vars
- [Deployment & Reverse Proxies](/getting-started/deployment/): Docker Compose + Caddy, Traefik, Nginx `/forward-auth`
- [Embeddable Rust Crates](/guides/embedded-crates/): `vaelspire-core`, `vaelspire-auth`, `vaelspire-axum`, `vaelspire-email`, `vaelspire-store-sqlite`, `vaelspire-store-postgres`
- [Forward-Auth Guide](/guides/forward-auth/): Session cookie & API-key verification and `X-Vaelspire-*` identity headers
- [Security Architecture](/guides/security-architecture/): Argon2id, keyed BLAKE3 digests, fail-closed cookies/origin/CSRF, transactional audit
- [Vaelspire Enterprise](/enterprise/overview/): Geo-replication, WORM storage, SIEM telemetry, offline Ed25519 seat licensing, FIPS 140-3
- [Public Roadmap](/roadmap/): Milestones M1 through M6 (OIDC IdP, Embedded UI, Rune Desktop, SAML/SCIM, Enterprise, Managed Cloud & FIPS)
